dcat_keyword_sm: Discrimination à l'égard des personnes en surpoids
dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains the full data extraction used for the scoping review titled "Nurses’ and Nursing Students’ Perceptions Toward People Living in Larger Bodies: A Scoping Review." It includes all extracted variables for the 34 empirical studies included in the review, such as study characteristics, methodological approaches, participant details, theoretical foundations, research settings, geographical information, and key findings.

The dataset reflects the complete extraction grid developed by the research team according to Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology and includes both initial and updated searches (up to June 10, 2025). It is intended to promote transparency, reproducibility, and secondary analyses by providing access to the full underlying dataset that informed the review.
dct_title_s: Complete Data Extraction Dataset for the Scoping Review on Nurses’ and Nursing Students’ Perceptions Toward People Living in Larger Bodies
